method.indexLimit: Directory reader exposed initial20A/B rows and VIEW MORE; guessed page2 inaccessible. Exhaustive frozen-roster branch URL traversal used instead of inferring pagination or adding tenants.
method.recovery: Official-domain exact-name search recovered indexed source references; reopening those references succeeded. Encoded JinDinRou and SomTamThai URLs repaired. No branch remains inaccessible after recovery.
method.scopeLimits: Official pages are retrieved/indexed representations, not independently refreshed live HTTP or on-site confirmation. Shell fetch failed socket access. Store block hours are used; generic footer hours are not assigned to branches.
method.brandDepth: Useful official brand product/menu pages and two explicit branch services were checked. Remaining independent brand/booking/services work stays explicit; no arbitrary page quota or exhaustive unavailable claim.

preservation.source: no src/runtime or tracker edits; no commit/push/deploy
